name: 现代简约组合办公桌款
description: 现代简约组合办公桌模版：大字场景首屏、编号卖点系列、三段细节与规格服务收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating flat pure-white #FFFFFF and light-grey #F0F0F0 infographic panels; the opening scene uses a plain light-grey wall #F0F0F0 with a white marble-vein floor; one small deep-green foliage sprig accents a corner of text panels
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even diffused neutral 5500K light; soft contact shadows only on scene shots; flat shadowless light on infographic screens
styleLock.surfaceSystem: high-gloss white desktop with dark trim edge and white marble-vein floor in the scene; flat matte grey and white panels elsewhere
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; heavy two-line Chinese headlines 36-48pt wrapped in 「」, 16-20pt subtitles, 10-14pt labels; small three-dot dividers; letter-spaced English micro-labels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line charcoal #2D2D2D icons with short labels; numbered advantage headers 01-04 with a thin vertical rule
styleLock.presentationRules: product appears only in the opening scene and detail crops; white body with dark trim edge rendered consistently; desk fully assembled with its side storage cabinet; stable scale, props never cover the product
noDrift: no invented certifications or test data
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: cool minimal modern office-furniture ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF and light grey #F0F0F0 flat panels, charcoal #2D2D2D text, one hazy-blue accent #7C9CCF, with small deep-green foliage accents in panel corners; neutral tone throughout; modern geometric sans-serif with heavy two-line Chinese headlines in 「」, small three-dot dividers and letter-spaced English micro-labels; alternating flat grey and white infographic screens with thin vertical rules and numbered advantage headers; thin-line charcoal icons with short labels; product shown fully assembled at stable scale with a white body and dark trim edge; layouts composed edge to edge with type, rules and foliage balancing every panel; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 源为 10 片 800×1200 详情页长图切片（_sources/办工桌/panels）。实际主产品是白身高光黑包边的现代组合办公桌（含侧柜）+办公场景，与文件名/文件夹名不符，已按图归类为 电脑办公/办公家具，与库内 suite-jiajujiafang-beiou-shiwushuzhuo（暖调实木家用书桌）为不同产品。已剥离：店铺名与品牌字样、产地、二维码与会员角标、所有原图文案；源图中部分灰块为未填充版面，已按其版式意图重建为产品细节图位。文案槽一律以 {selling_point}/{callout} 承接由商家回填，板材等级等资质类信息未写入模版正文，由生成时按真实产品填写。
